require('lib/std')

-- [AnimePlayer: error guard] script-message handlers and timers run through pcall: an error is written to <config>/uosc-errors.log
-- (send me that file) instead of silently stopping a redraw, and the rest of the UI keeps running.
do
	local log_path = mp.command_native({'expand-path', '~~/uosc-errors.log'})
	local function guard(where, fn)
		if type(fn) ~= 'function' then return fn end
		return function(...)
			local ok, a, b, c = pcall(fn, ...)
			if not ok then
				local f = io.open(log_path, 'a')
				if f then f:write(os.date('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), '  ', tostring(where), '\n', tostring(a), '\n\n'); f:close() end
				msg.error(tostring(where) .. ': ' .. tostring(a))
				return nil
			end
			return a, b, c
		end
	end
	local real_message, real_timeout = mp.register_script_message, mp.add_timeout
	mp.register_script_message = function(name, fn) return real_message(name, guard('script-message ' .. tostring(name), fn)) end
	mp.add_timeout = function(seconds, fn, ...) return real_timeout(seconds, guard('timeout', fn), ...) end
end
